description:
Hundreds of years ago, the crown prince who died in a conspiracy was reincarnated as Wang Dodo, a high school student. Dodo, who has regained his memory through past events, tries to revive the memory of Ryu Sehwan, a university student who is the reincarnation of the Heir Princess and continue his love with Princess Choi. At this moment, the secret of Dodo's death as Crown Prince is slowly revealed, and those who participated in the death begin to appear one by one...
